dayLines: You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 60s, with ink-stained fingers telling A person, maybe 40s about A woman, maybe 30s, with sun-creased eyes. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 50s returns with water: +4 clean.
🚶 A woman, maybe 40s is back — found A woman, maybe 30s, with sun-creased eyes.
"Hey." A person, maybe 60s settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 60s.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
A woman, maybe 30s, with sun-creased eyes is staring into the fire like it owes them answers.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek came back with 524 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
Stan and Zainab lingered over the fire together.
Xavier and Kelsey lingered over the fire together.
You remember the Crude bow at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
You remember the Work Gloves at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.

📓 Journal: the person in their 60s taught the woman in her 40s Wound Care.
🔧 Technique learned: tick removal.
A person, maybe 60s watches you scratch at your ankle and shakes their head. “Here — tweezers at the head, steady pull, don’t twist. Like this.” (You learned tick removal.)
— DAY 2 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.

🔥 Naran says it at the fire, not quite looking at Kelsey: “Your story about what you’re after doesn’t add up. Someone had to say it.” The fire goes quiet in the way it does when someone’s decided to be brave.

A person, maybe 60s looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)

A woman, maybe 30s, with sun-creased eyes folds their arms. "Sure. Your call. For now."
(Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
"Ashanti," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Ashanti." You'll remember that.

A woman, maybe 40s has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Omar is showing everyone big arrowhead leaves on long stalks rising from muddy water, with starchy corms below by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The journal grows — the human way.
★ IDENTIFIED: Taro. Big leaves in the mud, starchy corms underneath. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
You were listening. Now you know Taro too.

A person, maybe 60s spends the afternoon with the vine with thick-skinned round fruit — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. An hour passes. Then another. Nothing. The fire nods. That's dinner, maybe.

★ IDENTIFIED: Muscadine Grapes. Muscadine. Thick-skinned wild grapes. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
